messages:
Devin: Quick sync — Acme POC capacity ask. They gave two distinct profiles: steady chat at ~350 QPS (most convos short, ~30 tokens) + embedding spikes up to 250 r/s for nightly indexing. They want a reserved-gpu commit with burst autoscale. Who can map this to SKU+preheat?
Sasha: FYI I looked at their transcript samples. Chat is low-token but high concurrency. Embeddings are CPU-ish but they want GPU batches for speed.
Maria: @devin do we know their SLOs? 95th tail latency target?
Devin: Yes — 95th < 250ms for chat tokens, embeddings less strict (1–2s ok). Also they asked about price tiers for 12mo vs 6mo commits.
Kevin: Quick calc: if we target 40 effective QPS per A100-equivalent GPU (with our batching + kv-cache), baseline for steady chat = ceil(350/40) = 9 GPUs. Add burst headroom for embedding spikes and AZ failover => recommend reserved 11 GPUs, allow autoscale to 16 for bursts.
Kevin: Note: if we run quantized INT8 model variant for chat we get ~1.6x effective QPS => baseline could drop to 6 GPUs. Tradeoff is output parity risk.
Sasha: Can we propose two offers: (A) conservative: 11 reserved GPUs, autoscale to 16, 12mo commit with 22% discount; (B) aggressive: 6 reserved (quantized), autoscale to 12, 12mo with 28% discount + quality SLAs.
Maria: Security checklist — they require SOC2, BYOK KMS, and cross-region failover doc. Private deployment not on table but they want KMS integration for keys. Also need logs retention 90d.
Kevin: Ops notes for preheat: we should warm KV-cache and run a staged canary (10% traffic) for 1 hour before increasing to 50% then full. Preheat script snippet: 
```
# preheat plan
for p in $(seq 1 3600); do
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":8}' $ENDPOINT || break
  sleep 1
done
```
Use the smoke harness to validate latency tail.
deploy-bot: smoke-test finished — 5/5 canaries healthy, p95=210ms, p99=480ms. :white_check_mark:
Devin: Pricing question from sales: if we commit 11 GPUs for 12mo what mixing policy for burst would be ideal? Kevin?
Kevin: Recommend commit covers baseline 11 GPUs month average. Burst capacity uses reserved burst credits + autoscale on-demand. We can cap cost by: burst_credits=600s per GPU/day and throttle after credits exhausted. Example policy: 
```
burst_policy:
  credits_per_gpu_per_day: 600
  throttle_after_credits: true
  fallback_model: small-chat-quantized
```
Sasha: Customer asked whether reserved GPUs can be pinned to H100 instead of A100. We can offer an H100-priced option; perf gains allow lowering reserved count by ~25% but pricing higher.
Maria: Action items: 1) @kevin produce two SKU proposals (A100 baseline, H100 baseline) with preheat runbook and autoscale policy by EOD. 2) @sasha draft 12mo vs 6mo pricing tier language + commit discount numbers. 3) @devin gather SSO/KMS contact and send security questionnaire answers.
Devin: Sounds good. I'll also ask for sample daily spike traces so we can model hourly burst shapes. :eyes:
Kevin: I'll run quick perf sims on quantized variant and post numbers here.
Sasha: If we keep messaging tight, sales can include both options in the proposal. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll start preparing the SOC2 + KMS bullet answers for the questionnaire and flag anything that requires infra changes.
Devin: Great — thanks team. Will loop in account exec after Kevin posts sims.
